home.heroTitle: Overcoming, which has become a form.
home.heroSubtitle: Handmade sculptural objects for considered interiors. Each piece is cast, carved and finished by hand in a small studio, one at a time.
home.philosophyTitle: We believe that real strength is not always visible. It lives in the ability to go on, to remain yourself, and to take on a new form when the old one is no longer possible.

about.title: About
about.authorBody1: vkv.form began as a series of studies in balance — small clay forms made between other work, kept on a windowsill rather than sold. Over time the studies became a practice, and the practice became a small studio producing objects in short, considered runs.
about.authorBody2: Every piece that leaves the studio has passed through the same hands that shaped it. Nothing is outsourced, nothing is mass-produced — which is also why each run is limited, and why some forms do not return once they are gone.
about.philosophyTitle: Why we make what we make
about.philosophyBody1: Modern rooms are full of things that ask for attention. We wanted to make the opposite — objects that settle into a space quietly and reward a longer look rather than a first glance.
about.philosophyBody2: That means restraint in colour, honesty in material, and no two pieces that are perfectly identical. A vase with a slightly uneven rim is not a mistake to hide; it is proof that a person, not a mould alone, finished the work.
about.philosophyBody3: We work primarily in three families of material — unglazed stoneware, tinted plaster, and soft natural stone — chosen because they age well and because their surface changes gently with light and touch over years of use.

cookies.message: This site uses a small number of essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart — nothing is used for advertising or tracking.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This page explains, in plain language, what cookies and similar technologies vkv.form uses and why. We keep this deliberately short because we deliberately use very little.
cookiePolicy.essentialBody: When you sign in, our authentication provider (Supabase) sets a secure cookie so the site knows you're signed in as you move between pages. This cookie is strictly necessary for the site to function — without it, you couldn't stay logged in or view your orders — so it doesn't require consent under GDPR, but we mention it here for transparency.
cookiePolicy.localStorageBody: Items you add to your cart are stored in your browser's local storage, not a cookie, and not on our servers, until you check out. Clearing your browser data will clear your cart.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyBody: We do not use advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics. When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's own secure checkout page, which is subject to their own cookie and privacy policy, not ours.
cookiePolicy.rightsBody: Under GDPR, you can ask us what personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, and object to how it's processed. Since we store very little (an account email, order history, and anything you've explicitly saved), most requests can be handled quickly.
cookiePolicy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to the studio email listed on our Contact page.
